source: A shared-memory tiling strategy may reduce ZXNAME0000XZ traffic but consume enough shared memory to reduce block residency. A cache-persistent layout may improve L2 hit rate but add indexing or synchronization overhead. A fused kernel may eliminate an intermediate write yet create register pressure that lowers useful parallelism.
zh: 共享内存平铺策略可能会减少 ZXNAME0000XZ 流量，但会消耗足够的共享内存来减少块驻留。缓存持久布局可以提高 L2 命中率，但会增加索引或同步开销。融合内核可能会消除中间写入，但会产生寄存器压力，从而降低有用的并行性。
